# Credit Card Reports Parser

## What it does
A free, browser-based tool for parsing Israeli credit card statements from
Isracard, Cal (כאל), and Max (מקס). Upload an Excel or CSV export and get an
instant categorized expense summary.

## Capabilities
- Parses .xlsx, .xls, and .csv files exported from Isracard, Cal, and Max
- Automatically detects the card provider from the file structure
- Categorizes transactions into 17 groups: Food, Supermarket, Transport,
  Shopping, Utilities, Health, Entertainment, Education, Insurance,
  Subscriptions, Government, Pets, Telecom, Fuel, and more
- Supports multi-currency transactions (ILS, USD, EUR)
- Handles multiple files from different cards and billing periods at once
- Aggregates spending by vendor, category, and date
- Provides export of parsed results
- Bilingual UI (English and Hebrew)

## Privacy & Security
All processing runs entirely client-side in the browser using JavaScript.
No data is ever uploaded to a server. There is no backend or database.

## Supported Input
Excel (.xlsx, .xls) and CSV (.csv) files exported from the official Isracard,
Cal, or Max websites or mobile apps.

## Limitations
- Only supports Israeli credit card providers (Isracard, Cal, Max)
- Requires files in the original export format from the provider
- Does not support PDF statements
- Categorization relies on keyword matching; unknown vendors are labeled "Other"
- Requires JavaScript enabled in the browser
